shared_elements: low-relief carving of animal figure on a vertical surface
animal facing to the viewer's right
justification: Both surfaces depict a quadruped in profile rendered in low relief, but this is a near-universal motif and the species and treatment differ entirely: A shows a naturalistic humped camel led by a human figure, framed by a border band of rosettes and an ordered processional register, while B shows a small schematic feline-like animal with an elongated body and a separate reptilian/serpentine form below it, with no human figures, no border ornament and no register scheme. The arrangement (a bounded horizontal frieze versus isolated motifs stacked on a narrow upright shaft) and the proportions of the animals share nothing specific.
